questions.question: At which ground did Knights record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval — largest win by runs of 136, against Kei on 2018/11/25.

questions.question: This database's Partnership_By_Wicket records include a 151-run 7th-wicket stand from October 2024, involving Fay Cowling and one other player. That other player is a two-time World Championship medallist and an Olympic silver medallist. In which sport?
questions.explanation: That's Sunette Viljoen-Louw, an Olympic silver medallist (Rio 2016) and two-time World Championship medallist in javelin, who returned to domestic cricket over 20 years after her only Test cap.

questions.question: At which ground did Amanda Ngcobo record their career-best bowling figures (4-9, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Willowmoore Park Main Oval, against Eastern Storm on 2022/10/02.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Eastern Storm or Rhinos?
questions.explanation: Eastern Storm lead 14-7 across 23 meetings (List A).

questions.question: Kirstie Thomson set a database record (12/13 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 58. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Fastest 100 (by balls)', held by Kirstie Thomson.
